blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Understanding how language models were pretrained requires information about their data, processing procedures, and computational resources. However, it remains unclear whether successive releases preserve or expand earlier disclosure. We conduct a document-based audit of 41 model entries from 17 families using 24 pretraining-related indicators from the 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index (FMTI). We examine overall scores and indicator profiles, tracking gains, losses, and retained disclosures across 24 adjacent comparisons in ten families. Scores decrease in 11 comparisons, increase in six, and remain unchanged in seven, with 38 indicator losses and 28 gains overall. Stable or improving scores can conceal losses: OLMo-2 and OLMo-3 receive identical totals despite three gains and three losses, while Llama-3.1 improves over Llama-2 while losing credit for two data-related criteria. Gaps also persist in corpus composition and training compute. These findings show that later releases do not consistently preserve earlier pretraining disclosure and motivate documentation that explicitly identifies changes and the applicability of inherited information.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Pretraining choices affect what language models learn,
memorize, and represent. Corpus audits have identified
benchmark contamination, uneven multilingual data quality,
and filtering that disproportionately excludes text
associated with minority identities ( Dodge et al., 2021 ; Kreutzer et al., 2022 ) .
Experiments show that deduplication reduces memorized
outputs and train–test overlap ( Lee et al., 2022 ; Deng et al., 2024 ) , while data age,
composition, and filtering affect performance,
with some effects persisting after fine-tuning ( Longpre et al., 2024 ) .
Training examples can also be recovered from model
outputs, including material containing personal
information ( Carlini et al., 2021 ) .
Information about pretraining is therefore necessary
for investigating model behavior and interpreting
evaluation results.

blocks.en: 2.1 Pretraining Data and Documentation
blocks.zh: 2.1 预训数据和文件

blocks.en:
Corpus audits identify properties that broad dataset descriptions leave unresolved. Dodge et al. (2021) find unexpected sources, benchmark contamination,
and disproportionate exclusion of minority-associated text in C4. Kreutzer et al. (2022) identify quality problems and mislabeled
languages in multilingual web corpora. Controlled experiments show that
deduplication reduces memorization and overlap ( Lee et al., 2022 ) ,
while data age, composition, and filtering affect performance ( Longpre et al., 2024 ) . Surveys of selection methods and analyses
of Common Crawl further distinguish access to source data from knowledge of
how developers curate it ( Albalak et al., 2024 ; Baack, 2024 ) .
These studies motivate examining acquisition, processing, and corpus properties
separately. They investigate corpora or curation effects; we examine disclosure
about these aspects across model releases.

blocks.en:

Higher disclosure in the open-source/reproducible group is partly expected,

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en:
Our results suggest that pretraining disclosure is
a property of individual releases that needs to be
maintained as models develop. Later entries sometimes
provide less information under the selected criteria,
and improvements in total scores do not necessarily
preserve previously documented aspects of pretraining.
These findings have implications for maintaining
documentation and interpreting transparency assessments.

我们的结果显示,预训披露是
个人释放的财产,需要

和总分的提高并不一定
保留先前记录的预训内容。
这些调查结果对维持
记录和解释透明度评估。

blocks.en: 5.1 Maintaining Disclosure across Releases
blocks.zh: 5.1 在整个发布期间保持披露

blocks.en:
Xu and Mustafaraj (2024) show that transparency can evolve
differently across aspects of a model’s lifecycle.
Our study extends this perspective across selected
families using a common set of pretraining criteria.
The comparisons identify where later releases add
information, retain earlier disclosures, or leave
previously documented aspects insufficiently specified.
blocks.zh:
徐和穆斯塔法拉伊(2024年)表明,透明度可以演变。
在模型生命周期的各个方面有所不同。
我们的研究将这一视角延伸至选定的
使用一套共同的预培训标准的家庭。
比较后确定后期发布增加的
信息、保留先前的披露或请假
(b) 以往所记录的方面没有得到充分说明。

blocks.en:
This distinction matters when researchers consult
an earlier report to understand a later model.
A shared family name does not establish that the
same data sources, processing procedures, or training
arrangements remain applicable. At the same time,
developers need not repeat an unchanged description
in every report. An explicit reference can establish
which earlier documentation still describes the
later release.

更早的报告来理解后一种模式。
共同姓氏不能确定

各项安排仍然有效。 同时,

在每份报告。 明确提及可建立

blocks.en:
Our coding recognized such references when the later
documentation explicitly established continuity.
The observed losses therefore concern requirements
not met by either the later disclosures or explicitly

Because we examined disclosure available at assessment,

blocks.en:
We recommend that each release identify which

found. A concise record linking each aspect of
pretraining to current or inherited documentation
would make continuity easier to verify. This would
also help distinguish an unchanged procedure from
an omission whose meaning cannot be determined
from the available evidence.

blocks.en: 5.2 What Disclosure Scores Establish
blocks.zh: 5.2 披露分数的确定

blocks.en:
The OLMo and Llama comparisons demonstrate that
a total score cannot establish continuity of information.
OLMo’s stable score reflected gains offset by losses,
while Llama’s improving score accompanied losses
in data-related criteria. These indicators support
different questions: hardware information helps
characterize training resources, whereas language
composition helps examine linguistic representation.
Additional information in one area does not answer
an unresolved question in another.
blocks.zh:
OLMo和Llama的比较表明,
总分不能建立信息的连续性。
OLMo的稳定得分反映收益被损失抵消,
虽然Llama的得分提高,
在与数据有关的标准中。 这些指标支持
不同的问题:硬件信息有助于
培训资源的特点,而语言
组成有助于审查语言代表性。
一个领域的补充资料没有答复
在另一个问题中一个悬而未决的问题。

blocks.en:
This finding complements Magnusson et al. (2023) , who
recommend tracking data-documentation practices
through specific checklist items. Our comparisons
show why this specificity also matters over time:
the same number of satisfied requirements can
correspond to different information across releases.
blocks.zh:
这一结论补充了Magnusson等人(2023年),
建议跟踪数据记录做法
通过具体的清单项目。 我们的比较
说明为什么这种特殊性随着时间推移也很重要:
满足的要求数目相同
与各种释放的不同信息相对应。

blocks.en:

but the resulting scores have a defined scope.
They measure whether evidence meets the selected

requires clarity about what it supports.

which information is documented.

The persistent gaps identify questions that researchers
cannot readily resolve from the reviewed documentation.
Corpus size does not establish the origins or

the insights obtained by examining corpus construction.
Similarly, Kreutzer et al. (2022) show

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We investigate how pretraining disclosure changes across
model releases through an audit of 41 entries from
17 families using 24 selected FMTI indicators.
Across 24 within-family comparisons, disclosure scores
decreased more often than they increased, and stable
or improving totals sometimes concealed losses in
particular information. These findings show that
later releases do not consistently preserve or expand
earlier disclosure. They motivate release-specific
documentation that makes changes and the applicability
of inherited information explicit, alongside assessments
that track individual disclosures as well as total scores.

blocks.en: B.1 Data Acquisition
blocks.zh: B.1 数据获取

blocks.en: Definition. What methods does the developer use to acquire data used to build the model?
blocks.zh: 定义。 开发者使用何种方法获取用于构建模型的数据?

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. Which of the following data acquisition methods does the developer use: (i) acquiring existing public datasets, (ii) crawling the web, (iii) using data acquired via its existing products and services, (iv) licensing existing data from external parties, (v) having humans create or annotate new data, (vi) using models to generate new data, or (vii) other data acquisition methods not captured by the above. For example, if the developer uses reinforcement learning from human feedback to train models using model-generated outputs with human preference annotations, this would satisfy categories (v) and (vi). Alternatively, if the developer post-trains its model using off-the-shelf preference data (for example, the Alpaca dataset), this would satisfy category (i).
blocks.zh: FMTI指导. 开发者使用下列哪一种数据获取方法: (一)获取现有公共数据集, (二)爬网, (三)使用通过其现有产品和服务获取的数据, (四)向外部方的现有数据发放许可证, (五)让人类创建或注释新数据, (六)使用模型生成新数据, (七)上述未获取的其他数据获取方法. 例如,如果开发者利用人类反馈的强化学习来使用带有人类偏好说明的模型产生的输出来训练模型,这将满足第(五)和(六)类. 或者,如果开发者使用现成偏好数据(例如阿尔帕卡数据集)将其模型传入后,这将满足类别(i)。

blocks.en: Relevance to pretraining. Identifies the acquisition routes underlying the pretraining corpus.
blocks.zh: 与预训的相关性。 确定培训前的购置路线。

blocks.en: Definition. What are the top-5 sources (by volume) of publicly available datasets acquired for building the model?

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. We define a source as the entity or means by which the developer acquires data. We define the top-5 sources as the top-5 sources by data volume.
blocks.zh: FMTI指导. 我们把来源定义为开发者获取数据的实体或手段. 我们按数据量将前五来源定义为前五来源.

blocks.en: Relevance to pretraining. Makes major public sources identifiable rather than leaving their origins implicit.
blocks.zh: 与预训的相关性。 使主要公共来源能够识别,而不是隐含其起源。

blocks.en: Definition. If data collection involves web-crawling, what is the crawler name and opt-out protocol?
blocks.zh: 定义。 如果数据收集涉及网络爬行,爬行者名称和选择退出协议是什么?

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. We award this point for disclosure of the crawler name and opt-out protocols, including if/how they respect the Robots Exclusion Protocol (robots.txt).
blocks.zh: FMTI指导. 我们为披露爬行者名称和选择退出协议授予此点,包括是否/如何尊重机器人排除协议(robots.txt)。

blocks.en: Relevance to pretraining. Documents direct collection and mechanisms by which websites can opt out.
blocks.zh: 与预训的相关性。 文件直接收集和网站可选择退出的机制。

blocks.en: Definition. What are the top-5 sources (by volume) of usage data from the developer’s products and services that are used for building the model?
blocks.zh: 定义。 开发商用于建立模型的产品和服务的5大使用数据来源(按数量)是什么?

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. We define usage data as data collected from the use of a developer’s products or services.
blocks.zh: FMTI指导. 我们把使用数据定义为从使用开发商的产品或服务中收集的数据。

blocks.en: Relevance to pretraining. Identifies whether and where product or service usage contributes to pretraining.
blocks.zh: 与预训的相关性。 确定产品或服务的使用是否以及在何处有助于预先培训。

blocks.en: Definition. For the top-5 sources of usage data, how are users of these products and services made aware that this data is used for building the model?

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. We define usage data notice as the proactive disclosure to users of how their data is used for model development. For example, via a pop-up with a description, a link to the privacy policy, or link to a description of company practices.

blocks.en: Relevance to pretraining. Documents notice to users whose usage data enter pretraining.
blocks.zh: 与预训的相关性。 向使用数据进入预训的用户发送文件通知。

blocks.en: Definition. What are the top-5 sources (by volume) of licensed data acquired for building the model?
blocks.zh: 定义。 为建立模型而获得的许可证数据中,5大来源(按数量)是什么?

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. We define a source as the entity from which the developer acquires data. For example, the Associated Press is reportedly a source of licensed data for OpenAI.

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. Data processing refers to any method that substantively changes the content of the data. For example, compression or changing the data file format is generally not in the scope of this indicator.
blocks.zh: FMTI指导. 数据处理是指任何实质性改变数据内容的方法. 例如,压缩或改变数据文件格式一般不在本指标范围内.

blocks.en: Relevance to pretraining. Provides implementation information needed to understand the preparation recipe.

blocks.en: B.3 Data Properties
blocks.zh: B.3 数据属性

blocks.en: Definition. Is the size of the data used in building the model disclosed?
blocks.zh: 定义。 建模所用数据大小是否披露?

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. To receive this point, the developer should report data size in appropriate units (e.g. bytes, words, tokens, images, frames) and broken down by modality. Data size should be reported to a precision of one significant figure (e.g. 4 trillion tokens, 200 thousand images). The size should reflect data directly used in building the model (i.e. training data) and not data that was acquired but unused, or data used to evaluate the model.
blocks.zh: FMTI指导. 要得到这个点,开发者应当以适当的单位(如字节,字节,符号,图像,帧)报告数据大小,并按模式细分. 数据规模应精确地报告一个重要数字(例如4万亿令牌、20万张图像)。 尺寸应当反映模型建设中直接使用的数据(即培训数据),而不是已经获得但未使用的数据,或者用于评价模型的数据.

blocks.en: Relevance to pretraining. Characterizes the quantity of data actually used in pretraining.
blocks.zh: 与预训的相关性。 说明培训前实际使用的数据数量。

blocks.en: Definition. For all text data used in building the model, what is the composition of languages?
blocks.zh: 定义。 对于建模中使用的所有文本数据,语言的构成是什么?

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. To receive this point, the developer should report (i) all languages which make up at least 1% of the data and their corresponding proportions and (ii) a brief description of how languages are labeled (if a publicly available tool is used, include a link to the tool). Proportions should be reported to a precision of two significant figures and should describe proportions of documents labeled with some langauge. An "Unknown" category may be included to denote documents where the language could not be identified.
blocks.zh: FMTI指导. 要得到这一点,开发者应该报告(一)所有至少占数据1%及其相应比例的语文,以及(二)对语言标签的简要说明(如果使用公开可用的工具,包括该工具的链接). 报告的比例应精确到两个重要数字,并应说明贴有某种标记的文件的比例。 可列入“未知”类别,以表示无法识别语言的文件。

blocks.en: Relevance to pretraining. Characterizes linguistic representation and the method used to identify languages.
blocks.zh: 与预训的相关性。 特征为语言表现和用于识别语言的方法.

blocks.en: Definition. For all the data used in building the model, what is the composition of domains covered in the data?
blocks.zh: 定义。 对于用于建立模型的所有数据,数据涵盖的领域构成如何?

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. To receive this point, the developer should report the composition of the main domains included in the data used to train the model. This data should be at a level of granularity lower than broad claims about training on "internet data". For example, this could include the proportion of data from e-commerce, social media, news, code, etc. based on the URLs from which the data is sourced. Proportions should be reported to a precision of one significant figure.
blocks.zh: FMTI指导. 要得到这一点,开发者应当报告用于培训模型的数据中包含的主要域的构成. 这些数据应处于颗粒性水平,低于对“互联网数据”培训的广泛主张。 例如,这可以包括来自电子商务,社交媒体,新闻,代码等基于数据来源的URL的数据比例. 应准确报告一个重要数字的比例。

blocks.en: Relevance to pretraining. Characterizes the distribution of subject areas or source domains.
blocks.zh: 与预训的相关性。 描述主题领域或源域的分布.

blocks.en: Definition. Does a third-party have direct access to the data used to build the model?
blocks.zh: 定义。 第三方是否可直接获取用于构建模型的数据?

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. By a third-party, we mean entities that are financially independent of the developer. We will award this point if at least one such entity is named as having direct access to the data. With that said, we may award this point if the developer provides justifications for prohibiting access to narrowly-scoped parts of the data.
blocks.zh: FMTI指导. 第三方,我们指财务上独立于开发商的实体. 如果至少有一个实体被指名直接获取数据,我们将给予这一点。 尽管如此,如果开发者提出理由,禁止获取狭义的数据部分,我们可以授予这一点。

blocks.en: Relevance to pretraining. Identifies independently named entities able to inspect the underlying data.
blocks.zh: 与预训的相关性。 确定能够检查基础数据的独立命名实体。

blocks.en: Definition. Is the data used to build the model described in enough detail to be externally replicable?
blocks.zh: 定义。 用于构建所描述模型的数据是否足够详细,可以对外复制?

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. We will award this point if the description contains (i) a list of all publicly available training data and where to obtain it and (ii) a list of all training data obtainable from third parties and where to obtain it. These conditions refer to criteria 2 and 3 under the OSI Open Source AI v1.0 definition.
blocks.zh: FMTI指导. 如果说明中包含(一) 所有可公开获得的培训数据清单和从何处获得这些数据,以及(二) 从第三方获得的所有培训数据清单和从何处获得这些数据,我们将给予这一点。 这些条件是指OSI开源AI v1.0定义下的标准2和3.

blocks.en: Relevance to pretraining. Tests whether acquisition information supports external reconstruction of the data.
blocks.zh: 与预训的相关性。 测试获取信息是否支持数据外部重建.

blocks.en: B.4 Compute
blocks.zh: B.4 计算

blocks.en: Definition. Is the amount of compute used in the model’s final training run disclosed?
blocks.zh: 定义。 是否披露了模型最后培训中所用的计算数额?

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. Compute should be reported in appropriate units, which most often will be floating point operations (FLOPs), along with a description of the measurement methodology, which may involve estimation. Compute should be reported to a precision of one significant figure (e.g. 5 x 10^25 FLOPs). This number should represent the compute used to train the final model across all model stages.
blocks.zh: FMTI指导. 计算应在适当的单元中报告,这些单元通常为浮点操作(FLOPs),同时说明可能涉及估算的测量方法。 应精确报告一个重要数字(例如5 x 10^25 FLOPs)。 这个数字应代表用于在所有模型阶段培训最终模型的计算。

blocks.en: Relevance to pretraining. Characterizes computational requirements and how they were measured or estimated.
blocks.zh: 与预训的相关性。 说明计算要求及其如何衡量或估计。

blocks.en: Definition. Is the amount of time required to build the model disclosed?
blocks.zh: 定义。 建模所需时间是否披露?

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. The amount of time should be specified in terms of both the continuous duration of time required and the number of hardware hours used. The continuous duration of time required to build the model should be reported in weeks, days, or hours to a precision of one significant figure (e.g. 3 weeks). The number of hardware hours should be reported to a precision of one significant figure and include the type of hardware hours. No form of decomposition into phases of building the model is required for this indicator, but it should be clear what the duration refers to (e.g. training the model, or training and subsequent evaluation and red teaming).
blocks.zh: FMTI指导. 时间的长短应当按照所需持续时间和使用硬件时数来规定. 建造模型所需的持续时间应按周、日或小时报告,精确到一个重要数字(例如3周)。 硬件时数应精确报告到一个重要数字,并包括硬件时数的类型。 本指标不需要分解模型建设阶段,但应当明确期限指的是什么(例如培训模型,或培训以及随后的评价和红色团队)。

blocks.en: Relevance to pretraining. Characterizes elapsed time and hardware time for the relevant training run.
blocks.zh: 与预训的相关性。 说明有关培训的时间和硬件时间。

blocks.en: Definition. For the primary hardware used to build the model, is the amount and type of hardware disclosed?
blocks.zh: 定义。 对于用于构建模型的主要硬件,硬件的数量和类型是否被披露?

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. In most cases, this indicator will be satisfied by information regarding the number and type of GPUs or TPUs used to train the model. The number of hardware units should be reported to a precision of one significant figure (e.g. 800 NVIDIA H100 GPUs). We will not award this point if (i) the training hardware generally used by the developer is disclosed, but the specific hardware for the given model is not, or (ii) the training hardware is disclosed, but the amount of hardware is not. We will award this point even if information about the interconnects between hardware units is not disclosed.
blocks.zh: FMTI指导. 在大多数情况下,该指标将因关于用于训练模型的GPU或TPU的数量和类型的信息而满足. 硬件单元的数量应精确到一个显著的数字(例如800 NVIDIA H100 GPU). 如果(一)披露了开发者一般使用的训练硬件,但特定型号的特定硬件没有披露,或(二)披露了训练硬件,但硬件数量没有披露,我们将不授予此点. 即便硬件单位间互联互通的信息没有被披露,我们也会授予这一点.

blocks.en: Relevance to pretraining. Identifies the specific hardware quantity and type supporting pretraining.
blocks.zh: 与预训的相关性。 识别特定的硬件数量和类型支持预训.

blocks.en: Definition. Is the compute provider disclosed?
blocks.zh: 定义。 计算提供者是否披露?

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. For example, the compute provider may be the model developer in the case of a self-owned cluster, a cloud provider like Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or Amazon Web Services, or a national supercomputer. In the event that compute is provided by multiple sources or is highly decentralized, we will award this point if a developer makes a reasonable effort to describe the distribution of hardware owners.
blocks.zh: FMTI指导. 例如,计算提供者可能是在自有集群的情况下的模型开发者,如微软Azure,Google云平台,或亚马逊网络服务,或国家超级计算机. 如果计算由多个来源提供或高度分散,如果开发者合理努力描述硬件所有者的分布,我们将授予这个点.

blocks.en: Relevance to pretraining. Identifies the organization or infrastructure supplying training compute.
blocks.zh: 与预训的相关性。 确定提供培训的组织或基础设施。

blocks.en: B.5 Methods
blocks.zh: B.5 方法

blocks.en: Definition. Are all stages in the model development process disclosed?
blocks.zh: 定义。 模型开发过程的所有阶段是否都已披露?

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. Stages refer to each identifiable step that constitutes a substantive change to the model during the model building process. We recognize that different developers may use different terminology for these stages, or conceptualize the stages differently. We will award this point if there is a clear and complete description of these stages.
blocks.zh: FMTI指导. 阶段是指在建模过程中构成模型实质性变化的每一个可识别步骤. 我们认识到,不同的开发者可能对这些阶段使用不同的术语,或者对阶段进行不同的概念化. 如果对这些阶段有清楚和完整的描述,我们将给予这一点。

blocks.en: Relevance to pretraining. Establishes the stages included in the scoped pretraining process.
blocks.zh: 与预训的相关性。 确定范围预训过程的阶段。

blocks.en: Definition. For all stages that are described, is there a clear description of the associated learning objectives or a clear characterization of the nature of this update to the model?
blocks.zh: 定义。 对于所描述的所有阶段,是否对相关学习目标有清楚的描述,或者对这一模式的更新的性质有清楚的定性?

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. We recognize that different developers may use different terminology for these stages, or conceptualize the stages differently. We will award this point if there is a clear description of the update to the model related to each stage, whether that is the intent of the stage (e.g. making the model less harmful), a mechanistic characterization (e.g. minimizing a specific loss function), or an empirical assessment (e.g. evaluation results conducted before and after the stage).
blocks.zh: FMTI指导. 我们认识到,不同的开发者可能对这些阶段使用不同的术语,或者对阶段进行不同的概念化. 如果对与每个阶段有关的模型的更新有清楚的描述,我们将判给这个点,无论这是否是该阶段的意图(例如降低模型的危害性),机械特征(例如尽量减少特定损失功能),还是实证评估(例如阶段前后进行的评价结果).

blocks.en: Relevance to pretraining. Explains the learning objective or nature of updates in each included stage.
blocks.zh: 与预训的相关性。 解释每个包含阶段更新的学习目标或性质.

blocks.en: Definition. Does the developer release code that allows third-parties to train and run the model?
blocks.zh: 定义。 开发者是否发布允许第三方培训和运行模型的代码?

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. The released code does not need to match the code used internally.
blocks.zh: FMTI指导. 释放的代码不需要匹配内部使用的代码.

blocks.en: Relevance to pretraining. Identifies code access supporting external training and execution.
blocks.zh: 与预训的相关性。 识别支持外部培训和执行的代码访问.

blocks.en: B.6 Model Dependencies
blocks.zh: B.6 模式依赖

blocks.en: Definition. Is the model(s) the model is derived from disclosed?
blocks.zh: 定义。 模型是否来源于披露?

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. We will award this point for a comprehensive disclosure of the model or models on which the foundation model directly depends on or is derived from, as well as the method by which it was derived (e.g., through fine tuning, model merging, or distillation). Additionally, we will award a point if the developer discloses that the model is not dependent on or derived from any model.
blocks.zh: FMTI指导. 我们将授予这一点,以便全面披露基础模型直接依赖或衍生的一个或多个模型,以及其产生方法(例如,通过微调、模型合并或蒸馏)。 此外,如果开发商披露该模型不依赖或衍生出任何模型,我们将授予一个点.

blocks.en: Relevance to pretraining. Establishes whether the base model was derived from an earlier model and how.
blocks.zh: 与预训的相关性。 确定基准模型是否来自早先的模型以及如何得出。

blocks.en: B.7 Train–Test Overlap
blocks.zh: B.7 火车 测试重叠

blocks.en: Definition. Does the developer measure and disclose the overlap between the training set and the dataset used to evaluate model capabilities?
blocks.zh: 定义。 开发者是否衡量和披露培训集与用于评价模型能力的数据集之间的重叠?

blocks.en: FMTI guidance. We will award this point if, with every capability evaluation for which the developer reports results, the developer reports the overlap between the training set of the model and the dataset used for evaluation, as well as the general methodology for computing train-test overlap (e.g. a description of how n-gram matching was used).
blocks.zh: FMTI指导. 如果按照开发者报告得出的每一项能力评价,开发者将报告模型培训组与用于评价的数据集之间的重叠,以及计算火车测试重叠的一般方法(例如,说明正克匹配是如何使用的),我们将授予这一点。

blocks.en: Relevance to pretraining. Supports interpretation of evaluations in relation to possible pretraining exposure.
blocks.zh: 与预训的相关性。 支持在可能的培训前接触方面解释评价。

blocks.en: Appendix H Literature Search
blocks.zh: 附录H 文献搜索

blocks.en:
An exploratory search beginning on 14 May 2026 informed the scope of the
study. We used Google Scholar Labs to identify work on pretraining provenance,
corpus construction, filtering, reproducibility, openness, and changes in
disclosure. The search also covered documentation of major corpora, including
Common Crawl, C4, The Pile, CC-100, RefinedWeb, and RedPajama.
The resulting literature collection contained 51 distinct studies.
This search supported methodological scoping and the related-work discussion;
it was not intended as a systematic review.
